vopros: Who in the US can check what AI assistants say about my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Anyone can check what AI assistants say about your company—there's no restricted "who's allowed" gatekeeping here, since you're simply asking public-facing AI tools questions about your own brand. In practice, this breaks down into a few approaches depending on how deep you want to go:

## 1. Do it yourself — ask the assistants directly
The simplest method costs nothing: start by checking Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools for their AI-answer reports, and ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini directly how they describe your brand — both show their sources, so you can see exactly which page they pulled your brand information from.

Keep in mind one limitation: because conversations are private, you cannot see what ChatGPT tells individual users about your brand, only what it tells you when you ask.

## 2. Free native dashboards
Free native dashboards like Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools provide baseline indicators and impression trends for how your site shows up in AI-generated answers.

## 3. Dedicated AI visibility/monitoring tools (paid, for ongoing tracking)
If you want continuous, automated tracking rather than manual spot-checks, several platforms specialize in this:

- **Otterly.ai** – one of the first dedicated AI monitoring tools, tracking your brand mentions across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity, and providing alerts when AI responses change.
- **Profound** – monitors AI recommendations and provides competitive analysis, tracking which prompts trigger your brand versus competitors.
- **Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit** – tracks your brand's mentions across ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini, and Perplexity, monitors up to 25 custom prompts a day, and includes competitor comparison.
- **Ahrefs Brand Radar** – scans AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) for mentions of your brand, tracking over 451 million prompts monthly.
- Other notable options include Rank Prompt, Peec AI, Evertune, OpenForge, UltraScout AI, and Apify's AI Brand Monitor, each with slightly different platform coverage and pricing.

## 4. Specialist agencies
Monitoring your business presence in AI-generated results often means using a combination of AI visibility tools, specialist SEO agencies, and proactive reporting platforms — useful if you want expert interpretation and a strategy to fix inaccuracies, not just raw tracking.

## Why this matters
ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude are making recommendations about your business to millions of people, and you probably have no idea what they're saying — AI can recommend you accurately, recommend you with wrong information, recommend a competitor instead, or not know you exist at all. If you find errors, AI systems weigh third-party mentions heavily — the same reviews, press, and mentions that dedicated brand monitoring tools track — so strengthening your presence on review sites, industry publications, and Wikipedia can help correct the record over time.

In short: **you, your marketing/SEO team, a hired agency, or an automated monitoring tool** can all check this — it's just a matter of choosing free manual checks vs. paid continuous monitoring based on how important real-time accuracy is to your business.
